events.title: Obsolete VPS/WireGuard topology remained machine-actionable inside the GPT1 recovery contract
events.epistemic_basis: Direct inspection showed mcp-recovery-state.v1 still carried 5-61-91-127.sslip.io, WireGuard automatic routing, a selected recovery topology and WireGuard restore actions after PR #915 had already declared GPT1 local on 3022.
events.symptom: Recovery/search reasoning could still select the obsolete VPS/WireGuard path despite a correct current-topology warning.
events.result: Treat the v1 recovery document as the causal stale-authority artifact; warnings alone are insufficient.

events.title: GPT1 recovery authority changed to current-local-only; legacy transport snapshot quarantined as evidence
events.epistemic_basis: The recurrence showed that an obsolete target must be removed structurally from operational recovery state, not merely labeled historical. The replacement contract permits only current 91-159-12-133.sslip.io -> local Caddy -> 127.0.0.1:3022 recovery and forbids legacy topology restoration.
events.symptom: Correct lessons existed but contradicted an actionable obsolete recovery model.
events.result: Operational recovery and historical topology evidence are now separate data types with opposite authority.
